data.notes: July 2026 is unusually stacked for Malta, spanning open-air pop spectacles, jazz programming, and a heavy run of electronic club and festival events.

events.title: Isle of MTV Malta 2026: Katy Perry
events.summary: Katy Perry is confirmed on her official tour page for Isle of MTV Malta on July 22. Additional Isle of MTV Malta 2026 performers had not yet been fully announced at research time.

events.title: Malta Jazz Festival 2026
events.summary: Festivals Malta’s July jazz programme runs from July 6 to 11, including opening concerts, late-night sessions, and Ta’ Liesse concerts. Confirmed artists across the listed programme include Toninho Horta 4TET, Seamus Blake, Jeff Ballard, Kurt Rosenwinkel, and Terri Lyne Carrington.

events.title: EXIT Presents: Spiral Festival 2026
events.venueName: Gianpula Village / Café del Mar / Toy Room Beach Club
events.summary: EXIT’s new Spiral Festival debuts in Malta from July 31 to August 2 across Gianpula Village, Café del Mar, and Toy Room Beach Club. Confirmed artists include Fatboy Slim, Nina Kraviz, Lilly Palmer, Argy, LP Giobbi, Kasia, Layla Benitez, and more.

events.title: Michael Bublé Live in Concert
events.summary: Michael Bublé plays a one-night Malta concert at Park Nazzjonali Ta’ Qali on Wednesday, July 8. Eventworks lists the show time as 18:00 with ticket tiers starting at €40.

events.title: Cocoricò Presents Galactica Malta — Week 2
events.summary: Galactica returns to UNO Malta as a 10-date summer residency from Cocoricò, with the July 3 edition explicitly listed by RA. The night is billed as a hard-techno-focused Friday takeover, with lineups still to be announced.

events.title: BBC Concert Orchestra Presents: ABBA Versus Bee Gees
events.summary: BBC Radio 2 and the BBC Concert Orchestra return to Malta with a one-night open-air disco programme celebrating ABBA and the Bee Gees. The show is billed for Saturday, July 4 at The Granaries in Floriana with more than 70 musicians plus vocalists and a guest presenter.

events.title: G7 Presents MËSTIZA at Café del Mar
events.summary: MËSTIZA bring their electronic-and-Spanish-heritage fusion to Café del Mar Malta on July 18. The official ticketing page lists the event at 20:00 and describes the duo’s sound as blending afro, Arabic, and Latin influences.

events.title: Cocoricò presents Galactica Malta — July Residency
events.summary: Cocoricò’s Galactica returns to UNO Malta as a hard-techno summer residency, with July Fridays forming the core of the island takeover and promising big-room open-air techno energy.

events.title: Le Classico French Party — July Residency
events.summary: A major French diaspora club residency at Sky Club, with July Monday dates built around French rap, French Touch and remixes in a large-capacity Paceville setting.

events.title: UNO x Yakuza Present RIVO
events.summary: French DJ and producer RIVO headlines UNO Malta with support from Daniel Blade. The RA listing describes his sound as melodic techno with afro-driven rhythms and confirms the July 4 date.

events.title: G7 Presents Deborah De Luca at Café del Mar
events.summary: G7 presents techno headliner Deborah De Luca for a July 4 sunset-to-late session at Café del Mar Malta. RA lists the event for 20:00–01:00 at the Qawra venue.

events.title: MAMACITA Hip-Hop & Reggaeton at Gianpula Main Room
events.summary: Italy’s Mamacita club brand lands at Gianpula Main Room for July Tuesday dates, focused on hip-hop and reggaeton in a large summer club setting.

events.title: Robin Schulz at Café del Mar Malta
events.summary: Robin Schulz is listed by RA for a July 31 show at Café del Mar Malta from 20:00 to 01:00. The listing highlights his global dance hits including “Sugar,” “Waves,” and “Prayer in C.”

events.title: The Holy Rave Malta — July Thursdays
events.summary: French hard-techno brand The Holy Rave runs a Thursday summer residency at Tigullio, with July editions listed for 2, 9, 16, 23 and 30 July covering hard techno, bounce, acid techno and trance-leaning rave sounds.

events.title: Glitch Club Series: AEREA (live)
events.summary: Glitch Club Series hosts AEREA’s Malta debut, with a techno-focused live set blending trance, hardgroove and immersive club textures alongside local support.

events.title: Glitch Club Series: davyboi & Frederic
events.summary: Glitch Club Series returns to Club Phoenix with davyboi, Frederic and STK for a high-energy blend of techno, hard-house, trance, bounce and groove.

events.title: Techno Agency x O.S.M.W.S.T.A x T6E Resilience
events.summary: Two-stage Liquid Club takeover from Techno Agency, O.S.M.W.S.T.A and T6E Resilience, pitched at underground techno and minimal-techno heads.

events.title: DOSE: Techno Thursdays / Season III
events.summary: Flat8th’s DOSE series continues its Liquid Club summer run, centered on bounce, hard dance, hard techno and trance-influenced late-night club energy.

events.title: Summerlove Boat Party — 14 July Sailing
events.summary: A 250-capacity Sliema sailing party with resident DJ, open bar, R&B, reggaeton and dance music, aimed at the summer boat-party circuit rather than a conventional club room.
